mobbin:b9954846-af25-412f-856b-74fb74503.summary: From the timer list, user switches to Pomodoro, names/tags a focus session, starts through notification prompts, runs (including full-screen), reaches near-end, then hits the break phase and confirms skipping it.
steal: Ready: session label + project/person chip sit above a huge dial; full-width Start session; expand control for room-visible full-screen.
Running: Stop (pause clock) vs underlined End focus session (finish cycle)—two distinct end intents.
Full-screen: oversized digits + Stop / Exit full-screen for across-the-room readability.
Break: color/state flip (green Break / Relax!) and confirm modal before Skip this break.
avoid: Back-to-back in-app then system notification permission dialogs mid-run interrupt the live session—gate permissions before start.
mobbin:b9954846-af25-412f-856b-74fb74503.fit: Mobile (or propped tablet) beats SRV for in-room phase timers customers buy separately today; full-screen + phase colors replace dedicated digital timers—Pomodoro work/break labels would map to sim phases, not focus/break slang.

mobbin:110e340a-c8ad-43c7-b46e-1b58981b0.summary: From an empty timer list with a start tooltip, the list fills with today’s entries and restart plays, then suggestions plus activity, then multi-day history with favorites and a sticky start bar.
steps: Empty list + Start the timer tip
steal: Empty: illustration + tooltip pinned to the thumb-zone play button teaches first start.
List: each past entry has a one-tap play to restart the same named timer.
Suggestions: hideable quick-restart cards above activity for frequent phases.
Sticky bottom: “I’m working on…” + large play stays available while scrolling history.
avoid: List alone does not show an active running state or room-visible countdown—pair with a dedicated running/fullscreen surface for live sim phases.
mobbin:110e340a-c8ad-43c7-b46e-1b58981b0.fit: Mobile helps faculty/tech juggle multiple named phase timers on the floor (extends separate digital timers); restart-from-history is the win over desktop for repeating scenario phases.
